fields.text: **Do NOT compile the generated `ui/*.c` on native.** It's SquareLine-generated widget construction (regenerated each export) and is verified by the hardware compile + on-device visual check — not a unit-test target. Native tests cover *our* logic (`SLSSystemScreens`, `LVGLDisplayModule`) against mock `lv_obj_t` widgets. (Confirmed acceptable with the human mid-WO.)
Made `lv_label` stubs stateful rather than keeping tests structural — unlocks value assertions (SSID/URL/message population) for a few lines.
Same recipe (a stateful stub + a suite-local `ui`/board stub + drop the ignore) would revive `test_u8g2Display` and `test_application`, still dormant. Left for a separate item.
